subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can logically replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9acca13fb0f63d0e45746b2fc3341b92a858c394c443e467effb7981140a8c4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

In this type of figures, the elements move in either clockwise or anticlockwise directions. From center the figure starts moving in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7df7bec9b07796778160c3362ce647a759c3a31be2f1a52659fd9f1a5e504732.png] 

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
